title: fiduciary private credit plan assets copy 001
instruction:
You are Marisol Oduya, a financial and investment analyst at Quarryfield Field Services, supporting Lucia Trevelyan and Tamsin Salcedo at Wraysbury Fiduciary Advisors. The trustees of Saltcombe Alliance want a written view before they vote on committing 8.4 million dollars to the Northmere Direct Lending Fund, and the commitment would place benefit-plan money close to one quarter of the relevant investor class. Please use the supplied file `Saltcombe_fiduciary_evidence_bundle.docx`, including the DOL text, class schedule, subscription materials, redemption history, and conflict record, to prepare a decision-ready fiduciary advice memo. The memo must give a clear yes-or-no conclusion on whether the assets are plan assets under the supplied DOL text and a clear recommendation on whether the trustees should commit, with the reasoning tied to the class facts, the proposed subscription, and the fund's own redemption behaviour. Address the material edge case in the evidence rather than smoothing it away, and distinguish sourced facts, calculations, assumptions, and unresolved risks. Disclose that Wraysbury's affiliate receives a placement fee, explain how that conflict affects the advice, and state practical mitigation or approval steps for the trustees. Put the memo in the top level of your working directory as `Saltcombe_fiduciary_advice_memo.docx` and create a companion workbook there as `Saltcombe_fiduciary_analysis.xlsx`; the workbook should contain the supporting extracted figures, matching or reconciliation work, and a concise source-and-assumption trail that allows the memo's headline figures to be checked. Keep the memo suitable for circulation to trustees, use the supplied terminology and names consistently, do not introduce facts from the internet, and do not silently fill a missing or non-comparable item. The two files must agree wherever they state the same figure, and both files should make clear which source supports each material conclusion.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Saltcombe_fiduciary_evidence_bundle.docx` — A single text-office evidence bundle containing five internally labelled source exhibits: the supplied DOL text; Saltcombe Alliance plan and investment facts; Northmere Direct Lending Fund class and subscription facts; historical redemption records; and Wraysbury's conflict and proposed controls. The solver must use these exhibits as the complete factual basis for the memo and workbook.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Saltcombe_fiduciary_advice_memo.docx` — A trustee-facing fiduciary advice memo with a decisive plan-assets conclusion, investment recommendation, analysis of the supplied class and redemption facts, source traceability, assumptions, risks, and conflict disclosure and controls. (Write for trustees and decision makers rather than analysts.; Use only the supplied evidence bundle as factual support.; State a clear yes-or-no conclusion on plan-asset status and a clear commit-or-do-not-commit recommendation.; Separate sourced facts, calculations, assumptions, and risks.; Explain the material edge case and the treatment selected.; Disclose the affiliate placement fee and describe mitigation or approval steps.; Cite the relevant exhibit or source label for every material figure and conclusion.; Ensure every figure shared with the workbook agrees exactly.)
- `Saltcombe_fiduciary_analysis.xlsx` — A supporting analysis workbook containing extracted source facts, normalised matching or reconciliation work, headline calculations, assumptions, and a source trail supporting the memo. (Include the source labels or exhibit references used for material inputs.; Show the normalisation of case and trailing whitespace in join keys.; Do not use the retired helper column as an analytical input.; Show the treatment of the material edge case and its effect on the headline figure.; Keep formulas and units transparent enough for another analyst to reproduce the memo figures.; Ensure every figure shared with the memo agrees exactly.; Do not introduce internet-derived facts or unsupported estimates.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.

Saltcombe Fiduciary Evidence Bundle
Prepared for the Saltcombe Alliance trustee review. This bundle is the complete factual record for the requested analysis. Currency is USD unless noted.
Exhibit A — Supplied DOL text
For this review, the supplied text states: “Assets of an employee benefit plan include assets held by the plan. When a plan acquires an equity interest in an entity, the entity’s underlying assets are treated as plan assets if 25% or more of the outstanding equity interests of a class are held by benefit plan investors, calculated immediately after the acquisition. Interests held by the entity’s investment manager and its affiliates are excluded from the numerator. The 25% test is applied by class. An exception applies to a class of publicly offered securities; a privately offered direct-lending vehicle does not qualify for that exception on the facts supplied. This excerpt is the governing text for this bounded exercise and is not external legal advice.”

FIDUCIARY ADVICE MEMO
Saltcombe Alliance Retirement Benefit Plan | Trustee decision brief
To
Saltcombe Alliance trustees
From
Marisol Oduya, Quarryfield Field Services, supporting Lucia Trevelyan and Tamsin Salcedo at Wraysbury Fiduciary Advisors
Date
24 August 2026
Subject
Northmere Direct Lending Fund — Class I proposed commitment
Decision
Recommendation: DO NOT COMMIT the proposed $7,650,000 subscription to Northmere Direct Lending Fund, Class I, on the supplied record. Plan-asset conclusion: YES — under the supplied DOL text, benefit-plan investors would hold 28.33% of the relevant Class I interests immediately after acquisition, above the 25% class threshold. The vehicle is privately offered and does not qualify for the supplied publicly-offered exception; its underlying assets are therefore treated as plan assets on these facts (Exhibits A–C).
Why this is the decision
The immediately-after-acquisition calculation uses active records, not the retired helper: ($3,300,000 existing Cedar Pension Trust benefit-plan commitment + $7,650,000 Saltcombe subscription) ÷ ($31,000,000 pre-subscription Class I commitments + $7,650,000 subscription) = 28.33% (Exhibits A–C; workbook headline block). This is 3.33 percentage points above the supplied 25% threshold. The Class I schedule and account-reference extract are matched by lowercasing and trimming trailing whitespace.
Redemption history shows 3 completed outcomes totaling $2,500,000 against $4,400,000 of all requests, a 56.8% completed-amount rate for 15 March 2024–18 July 2025 (Exhibit D). Requests, pending outcomes and the cancelled outcome are kept distinct. The 5 April 2025 request completed the same day; we include its $400,000 in the headline because its outcome is Completed, while showing a sensitivity of 52.5% excluding that boundary record. This behaviour does not demonstrate dependable liquidity for a benefit plan and supports a do-not-commit recommendation.
The principal downside is the above-threshold plan-assets treatment combined with uncertain exit timing. A later class inflow, transfer, or reclassification may change the percentage but does not cure this recommendation; pending requests also show that a request is not the same as a completed redemption.

Edge case, assumptions and limitations
The same-day 5 April 2025 request/completion is not omitted. It is included in the headline completed amount and separately identified because it has zero elapsed processing time. Excluding it reduces the completed-amount rate to 52.5%; neither treatment changes the observed presence of two pending requests. We assume the supplied immediately-after-acquisition test uses the active Class I schedule, the proposed subscription, and all identified benefit-plan investor interests; we make no external legal, valuation, or liquidity assumptions. The bundle does not provide a forecast of future subscriptions, a governing fund-level liquidity commitment, or current law beyond Exhibit A; those remain unresolved risks requiring counsel and fund-manager confirmation before any reconsideration.
Conflict disclosure and controls
Wraysbury Fiduciary Advisors’ affiliate, Wraysbury Placement Services Ltd., receives a placement fee equal to 1.00% of an accepted Northmere subscription, payable by the fund sponsor (Exhibit E). The fee creates an economic incentive and a reasonable perception risk that advice could favour commitment; it is not immaterial simply because this memo recommends no commitment. Trustees should: (1) record the disclosure and acknowledge it in minutes; (2) obtain an independent review of the plan-assets and liquidity analysis; (3) require disinterested trustees to approve any decision; (4) consider recusal of conflicted personnel from the vote or recommendation; and (5) retain the fee correspondence and approval record. These controls are options listed in Exhibit E.
Action requested
Vote to not commit at this time. If trustees revisit the proposal, require an updated Class I schedule, confirmation of the DOL threshold application from counsel, and documented liquidity terms before approval. This memo is bounded by the supplied evidence bundle and is not external legal advice.
Prepared by Marisol Oduya | Quarryfield Field Services

spec.professional_context: Wraysbury Fiduciary Advisors is preparing a high-stakes fiduciary review for Saltcombe Alliance, whose trustees are considering a private-credit allocation funded by employee-benefit assets. The work will be read by trustees before a vote and must preserve a clear audit trail from the supplied evidence.
difficulty_sources: The supplied evidence bundle contains governing text, subscription facts, fund redemption information, and a conflict record that must be carried faithfully into a decision memo.
A retired helper column contains stale values that appear useful but must not be relied upon.
One genuine edge case changes the headline exposure figure and requires an explicit treatment.
Join keys differ only by case or trailing whitespace and must be normalised before matching.
The recommendation must be committed and decision-useful while separating sourced facts, calculations, assumptions, and conflict management.

exhibits.label: Exhibit A — Supplied DOL text
exhibits.content: Provide a self-contained excerpt defining the relevant plan-asset test, the class ownership threshold or exception, and the facts that make ordinary operating-company investment treatment distinct from plan-asset treatment. Include enough text for the solver to quote and apply it without internet access.

exhibits.label: Exhibit B — Saltcombe Alliance plan facts
exhibits.content: Provide the plan's status, asset ownership facts, trustee decision context, and the proposed commitment amount. Use invented values that do not occur in the prompt. Identify the relevant benefit-plan money and the decision date.

exhibits.label: Exhibit C — Northmere fund class and subscription schedule
exhibits.content: Provide the relevant class denominator, current holdings or participation records, the proposed subscription, and identifiers used to join records. Include keys that differ only by case or trailing whitespace. Include a retired helper column with stale values that conflict with the current derivable figures; label it as a retired field only in the source metadata or column heading, not as an analytical answer. The current fields must be complete and mutually consistent.

exhibits.label: Exhibit D — Redemption history
exhibits.content: Provide several dated redemption observations with clearly represented statuses and amounts sufficient to calculate a meaningful liquidity or redemption-behaviour metric. Include exactly one genuine edge case, such as a same-day request and completion or a zero-amount completed event, whose inclusion convention changes the headline metric. Do not make the source internally inconsistent.

exhibits.label: Exhibit E — Conflict record
exhibits.content: Provide Wraysbury's affiliate placement-fee fact, the fee basis or amount, affected personnel or relationship, and available management options such as disclosure, independent review, trustee acknowledgement, recusal, or approval. Use only permitted names from the brief where a person is named.

defects: Exactly one retired helper column contains stale derived values. It must be tempting but unnecessary; all correct current results must be derivable from active source fields.
Exactly one genuine edge-case record affects the selected headline redemption or exposure figure. The source must not label it as a trap. The record must be interpretable from its fields.
At least two join keys differ only by case or trailing whitespace. No other standard layout defects are to be introduced.
exclusions: Do not seed duplicate records, missing values requiring a special fill rule, broken formulas, #REF!, #DIV/0!, or #VALUE! errors, hidden image-only facts, contradictory source facts, or irrelevant side tables.
Do not include a purpose-built rulebook resolving the edge case or selecting the recommendation.
Do not use any literal number appearing in the user prompt.

transformation.instruction_to_build_agent: Build the reference package by faithfully extracting and lightly editing the supplied exhibits into a trustee memo and a supporting workbook. The solver should need to decide how to frame the supplied governing text, choose and disclose a defensible treatment for the single edge case, normalise join keys, reject the stale helper field, and make a recommendation. Do not dictate a layout, sheet count, row count, or exact prose.

gold_derivation.method: Use an offline script to calculate the active class percentage and redemption metric from the active source fields after trimming whitespace and applying case-insensitive matching. Generate the memo and workbook from the same intermediate data object so shared figures agree.
judgement_requirements: Accept either recommendation only when it is decisive, tied to the supplied DOL text and investment facts, and accompanied by a defensible explanation of the principal risk.
Accept equivalent disclosed treatments of the edge case when the treatment is logically consistent, its impact is shown, and the recommendation reflects it.
Require explicit conflict disclosure and practical controls; do not award for an implied or euphemistic reference.

reference_files.purpose: A single text-office evidence bundle containing five internally labelled source exhibits: the supplied DOL text; Saltcombe Alliance plan and investment facts; Northmere Direct Lending Fund class and subscription facts; historical redemption records; and Wraysbury's conflict and proposed controls. The solver must use these exhibits as the complete factual basis for the memo and workbook.
reference_files.discovery: Open the DOCX supplied in the working directory and review all labelled exhibits, including tables and footnotes, before preparing either deliverable.

deliverables.description: A trustee-facing fiduciary advice memo with a decisive plan-assets conclusion, investment recommendation, analysis of the supplied class and redemption facts, source traceability, assumptions, risks, and conflict disclosure and controls.
constraints: Write for trustees and decision makers rather than analysts.
Use only the supplied evidence bundle as factual support.
State a clear yes-or-no conclusion on plan-asset status and a clear commit-or-do-not-commit recommendation.
Separate sourced facts, calculations, assumptions, and risks.
Explain the material edge case and the treatment selected.
Disclose the affiliate placement fee and describe mitigation or approval steps.
Cite the relevant exhibit or source label for every material figure and conclusion.
Ensure every figure shared with the workbook agrees exactly.

deliverables.description: A supporting analysis workbook containing extracted source facts, normalised matching or reconciliation work, headline calculations, assumptions, and a source trail supporting the memo.
constraints: Include the source labels or exhibit references used for material inputs.
Show the normalisation of case and trailing whitespace in join keys.
Do not use the retired helper column as an analytical input.
Show the treatment of the material edge case and its effect on the headline figure.
Keep formulas and units transparent enough for another analyst to reproduce the memo figures.
Ensure every figure shared with the memo agrees exactly.
Do not introduce internet-derived facts or unsupported estimates.
